proof_review.method: Independent targeted readings of the three finite-central appendices, root integration, primary-source hypothesis checks and comparison of the main A-D statements with their proofs. core_checks: Jacobian etale saturation, universal centers, weight-zero Hom bundle, rank-four torsor, arbitrary-coefficient full faithfulness and irreducibility/finite type.

All-Artin envelope flatness: CFT multiparameter naturality, Lowen affine localization comparison, Yekutieli Cor11.2 with moving commutative products, and the actual transformation between functors represented by the same complete ring.
Framed fpqc descent, Amitsur logarithm correction, section derivations and vanishing of ordinary 1-groupoid automorphism classes; no elimination of dg scalar pi2.
Finite-width Koszul torsion, central quotient coinduction, genuine A-bimodule duality, strict dg localization, two-sided Q localization and relative Serre trace under nonflat coefficient changes.
Formal Ku recognition, coefficient-perfect effectivity, noncircular enriched Serre comparison, Serre-stable thick generation, perfect-kernel finite presentation and Torelli descent.

Scheme-theoretic first-order point liftability, finite point decomposition, regular cubic cut, tensor-representative independence, reconstruction of the quadratic envelope and scaled hPi_F, Casimir space, Hesse obstruction and modular residue.

Universal PBW: homogeneous fibre inputs, constant rank over the reduced finite-type coefficient base, injectivity in finite summands of the filtered direct sum, and projective splittings before arbitrary base change.

Relative CY: actual left B tensor Bop module convention, noncommutative Hessian order and flip, cochain dual signs (+,-,+,-), finite filtered exactness, and the left/right actions on the central-difference Koszul dual giving Theta(B/P)=B(5)[-5].
Five-dimensional Koszul resolution: bounded reduced bar comparison in each total degree, finite-projective W_i, W_6=0, and arbitrary base change through split finite models.

Full O-preserving Hom: coherent comparison of every even-section Z-algebra component, Serre choices restricted to the heart in the field-valued bounded version and to all even orbit objects in the arbitrary-base compact version, relative ample finite quotients for noetherian objects, and fpqc descent of Hom between fixed models before stackification.

Serre-stable generation: Stevenson all-localizing classification via the compact part and Kar(D_sg), automatic affine action stability, Orlov ungraded flatness hypotheses, grading/forgetting, compact extraction, and rotation R=S[-1].

Finite centers: nonnegative exhaustive filtration, Rains at closed points, constant commutator ranks over a reduced Jacobson base, lifted symbols and finite generation; no unchecked extension of the closed-point argument to nonreduced coefficient bases.

Relative categories: big QGr and quasi-coherent finite-algebra sheaves for arbitrary coefficient rings, coherent parts and ample-sequence comparison over noetherian rings, and compact=local Perf on quasi-compact separated models without noetherianity.

Finite-order regularity: CCKM finite-syzygy matrix factorizations and chart contraction; RSV finite relative diagonal with flat syzygies and all geometric field fibres; YZ/Chen duality for exact tails dimension three.

Global smoothness: ELS external-product generation for arbitrary chosen generators, left/right module conventions, diagonal evaluation and Morita comparison. The 15/16-dimensional torsion families do not establish the general 17-dimensional point.

Main A-D domains: ordinary coefficient rings; projectively graded ambient target; framed ordinary Artin neighbourhood in the full M, whose commutative point is outside C_J; nonempty point open C_J,pt and its intersection with the residual open U.

Bridge proposition: h!=0 gives the 17-parameter relations, followed by a nonempty inverse image of the Delta and etale-chart opens. The exact a=1/6, b=0, h^6=-1728 example shows that the bridge denominator alone does not guarantee quantum elliptic smoothness.
